task: ARPipe R1 Telemetry Analysis and Acquisition-Resolution Experiment Design
final_verdict: TELEMETRY ANALYSIS COMPLETE — NEXT EXPERIMENT SPECIFIED

statistical_restriction.rule: The R1 deterministic test matrix is a synthetic test fixture and NOT a random sample of historical failures. Population failure rates, historical prevalence, or probability distributions must NEVER be computed from this matrix.

HISTORICALLY_ESTABLISHED: 318 company-years lost at DISCOVERED -> DOWNLOADED transition on 2026-09-11 (pm5_stage_table.csv).
Historical reason-code completeness was 0.0% (all 318 coded REASON_CODE_MISSING).
Pre-R1 fetch code silently returned None on exhausted 403/429/503 and logged network exceptions only to stderr.
All 194 successful downloads occurred within a single 4.5-minute burst on 2026-09-11 (live_store_documents.jsonl).
Strictly 8 fiscal years had 0 successful archive downloads (FY2010, 2014, 2016, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023).
CURRENTLY_REPRODUCED: Archive endpoint nsearchives.nseindia.com exhibits temporal access variation across sub-hour windows (0/9 at 13:17 UTC vs 10/10 at 13:59 UTC vs 50/50 at 14:40-15:20 UTC).
Zero-download URLs sampled in P-C0 return valid payloads when the server is responsive.
Client configuration asymmetry (cookies, Referer, browser headers) does NOT explain failures (10/10 identical success in P-C0R).
R1 non-blocking attempt-level failure telemetry operates without altering acquisition behavior (32/32 tests pass).
UNKNOWN: Historical HTTP status code distribution for the 318 losses.
Historical exception distribution for the 318 losses.
Historical failure layer distribution for the 318 losses.
Historical retry-exhaustion distribution for the 318 losses.
Exact historical request dispatch timing and ordering on 2026-09-11.
Exact historical client machine IP/proxy/network environment on 2026-09-11.
RULED_OUT: Pre-fetch filter hypothesis (cohort_fetch_manifest.jsonl was a post-hoc labeling artifact).
Client header/cookie asymmetry as current failure cause (P-C0R 10/10 paired arms both succeeded).
Persistent payload corruption for successful downloads (valid ZIPs and PDFs verified).
R1 behavioral drift (15/15 test matrix fixtures identical).

remaining_hypotheses.name: Transient Endpoint Instability / Transport Collapse
remaining_hypotheses.distinguishing_observation: Live failure telemetry records first_failure_layer in ('L1_CONNECT', 'L4_RECEIPT') with status_code=null and ConnectError, ReadTimeout, or ConnectionResetError.

remaining_hypotheses.name: Rate / Cadence Limiting by Origin or CDN
remaining_hypotheses.distinguishing_observation: Live failure telemetry records first_failure_layer='L3_HTTP' with status_code=429 (Too Many Requests) or 403 (Akamai challenge).

remaining_hypotheses.name: Temporal Window / Operational Schedule Restriction
remaining_hypotheses.distinguishing_observation: Acquisition success/failure correlates strongly with time-of-day (e.g. market hours vs off-market maintenance) across identical URLs.

remaining_hypotheses.name: URL-Specific Missing or Corrupt Artifacts
remaining_hypotheses.distinguishing_observation: Specific un-downloaded URLs fail persistently with 404 or L6_VALIDATION while control URLs succeed in the same window.

remaining_hypotheses.name: Historical Invocation Gap / Batch Abortion
remaining_hypotheses.distinguishing_observation: External execution audit or archival evidence confirming batch script abort on 2026-09-11.

information_gap: Absence of layer-classified, attempt-level failure telemetry on candidate un-downloaded URLs during live acquisition, leaving transport collapse (L1/L4) indistinguishable from HTTP rejection (L3 403/429) and URL invalidity (L3 404 / L6).

proposed_next_experiment.name: Instrumented Acquisition Telemetry Pilot
proposed_next_experiment.objective: Deploy frozen R1 attempt-level telemetry (r1-v1) in a controlled live acquisition probe against the frozen 10-observation sample across 3 scheduled temporal windows, capturing structured telemetry on any failures to distinguish transport collapse (L1/L4) from HTTP rejection (L3) and validation failure (L6).
proposed_next_experiment.population_inclusion_rule: The 10 pre-frozen observations in reports/pc0_sample_manifest.json: 5 target observations from strictly zero-download fiscal years (FY2010, 2014, 2016, 2021, 2022) with discovered=True and downloaded=False; and 5 control observations from non-zero download fiscal years (FY2012, 2013, 2017, 2018, 2024) with downloaded=True.
proposed_next_experiment.sampling_rule: 100% census of the frozen 10-observation manifest. No sampling, no replacement, no substitution, no adaptive exclusion.
proposed_next_experiment.independent_variable: Temporal observation window: Probing across 3 pre-scheduled temporal windows separated by 30 minutes (T+0, T+30, T+60 minutes).
controlled_variables: Client configuration: Standard unseeded httpx.Client (proven invariant in P-C0R).
Request ordering: Fixed deterministic sequence (Observations 1 through 10).
Pacing: HostLimiter with 2.0s minimum delay between requests.
Retry policy: Frozen production policy (retries=3, timeout=120s, backoff 5*(attempt+1)^2).
Telemetry sink: Active local JSONL sink using arpipe.telemetry.TelemetryWriter (--telemetry-path).
measurements: Acquisition outcome per observation (StoredDoc vs None vs exception)
Per-attempt R1 JSONL telemetry records (attempt_number, terminal_state, retry_exhausted, error_type, status_code, first_failure_layer, exception_class, bytes_received, elapsed_ms, url_sha256)
proposed_next_experiment.attempt_schedule: 3 observation windows: Window 1 (T+0 min), Window 2 (T+30 min), Window 3 (T+60 min). 10 observations per window, up to 3 retries each.
stop_conditions: Immediate halt if remote host issues IP-ban / block signature.
Immediate halt if telemetry writer fails to write to disk.
what_it_cannot_prove: Cannot prove historical cause of the 318 losses on 2026-09-11.
Cannot prove behavior of unsampled zero-download FYs (2019, 2020, 2023) or unsampled companies.
Cannot prove response of server to full 512-request burst.

production_change_decision.rationale: Historical root cause remains unknown. Live failure layer distribution has not yet been observed. P-C0R proved 100% success under standard client configurations during open windows and ruled out header asymmetry. Changing retries, backoffs, headers, or session parameters before observing live telemetry would constitute blind speculation.
